items.description: A stock count. It names the product by 'Sku', or by 'ContentItemId' and, for a variant, 'VariantId'.

Sku.description: The SKU of the product or variant. Used when the ids match nothing, so it matches on any site.

ContentItemId.description: The content item id of the product. A product imported by an earlier step of the same recipe is synced before it is counted.

VariantId.description: The id of the product's variant, when the count is for a variant.

OnHand.description: The counted quantity on hand, a whole number of zero or more.
